create.name: WCCM Belgium (Christelijke Meditatie België)
create.bio:
Christelijke Meditatie België is the Flemish, Dutch-speaking association through which the World Community for Christian Meditation works in Belgium. It teaches the contemplative prayer handed on by John Main, the Benedictine monk who found in the early desert tradition a way of praying without words: sitting still each morning and evening and silently repeating a short prayer word, letting thoughts pass and coming back to the word. Like the wider community, it treats meditation as shared wisdom that can build understanding between faiths and cultures.

Much of its activity is online. Meditators gather on Zoom on Wednesday evenings and early on Monday and Friday mornings, each session pairing a short reading and instruction with twenty-five minutes of silence and a short exchange. It runs a free ten-week email programme for beginners, sends a short monthly reflection, publishes Dutch translations of John Main and Laurence Freeman and offers material for meditating with children. It is registered in De Klinge, in East Flanders.
